cards.back: moles = grams ÷ molar mass (g/mol, summed from the periodic table); particles = moles × 6.02 × 10^23. Always pass through moles before applying a coefficient ratio.
Convert each reactant to moles and divide by its coefficient. The smallest quotient is the limiting reactant, and only it sets the theoretical yield. Never compare grams directly.
